resources.string: Put a page on the network at an address you own. Readable offline, mirrored by whoever chooses to.
A page is a small site at an address that is yours for good. Write one and anyone with the address can read it.
Anyone with this address can read your page.
A page lives where someone serves it. Until a reader chooses to keep it alive, that is this phone — close DUCAT and the page goes quiet until you open it again.
Everything here goes on the page. Leave a field blank and it is left out.
Published. The address has not changed.
Pick a .zip with index.html at its root. It must not reference anything outside itself — a page that reaches the network is refused here rather than breaking on someone else\'s phone.
